collision_support.method: collision-support-v3: Geometry/Roadway/View-Geometry support; near-horizontal Geometry/Roadway slopes use local footprint heights, not whole-triangle height span; 0..0.08m below; 12cm footprint; 50cm vertical clearance against Geometry/Roadway only (View-Geometry occluder boxes never block); building roof and eight wall rays; stock proxy tables only; proxy marker faces excluded; no visual fallback

current_model_reaudit.method: Use full-client PBOs: dedicated-server visuals/collision are stripped. Preserve prior coordinates; refresh model pins and require current collision support/enclosure. Every refusal includes its coordinate. Static evidence only; native pending.

hc_floor_generation.method: hc-floor-v2: native stock points on building Geometry/Roadway floors seed a 0.50m walk lattice; every cell needs a clear standing body (0.22m radius, 1.8m) and a swept same-storey corridor with sampled floor from a reached neighbour (closed doors block); points avoid stock spawn discs (stock range + 0.5m), 1.0m of door leaves and stair steps (highest collision plane at each neighbour, never slab undersides); floor item base clears the highest Geometry/Roadway footprint sample by 5mm (local height span <=25mm); wall-side cells first, farthest-point spacing 1.5m, one point per 8m2 reached (2..12); collision support/enclosure gate before admission; optional props block bodies and points
